title: Provenance
thesis: Of twenty-nine specimens in the permanent collection, three may be shown freely, fifteen require a rights note, and eleven cannot be shown at all. The museum currently displays zero: eighteen are declined and eleven are unavailable. Fifteen depict an identifiable person. Five depict a person who was a child at the time.
closing: The museum's central finding is administrative rather than theoretical. The ideas belong to everyone. The images belong to somebody.
